posts.subject: Going away for a while/pc is shit
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello everyone, I making this fast post saying that I'll be away on the 15th ---> 22th (ofcourse July) cause going to Corfu which is a island in Greece. More or less yeah a VACaction for a alil while


THE SECOND PROBLEM IS. I don't know why but my computer have been turning off by itself, especially if I play games such as the more hurtful one "Cs:Go" and any other game. I haven't found the problem yet tho, @Mr. Baguette (haha...mr. Baguette) was very nice to help me and much has he could. I did some searcing myself and it could be my PSU who is maybe not giving enough power anymore (cause it's old) or it could be overheating which I tried to fix more or less and this is what I have been doing so far


-Cleaned out my pc with an air pressure can.
-Rebooted my whole system/pc
-Set the fans go faster to cooldown my graphics card and what not
-Checked my cables that they aren't any important unplugged


If anyone has any idé what can cause this (and yes my pc had some years on it so could be that aswell) but if not if you know something about computers it would help alot. If not please don't comment and thinking you know something. Otherwise I'll take all the help I could


Fast spec on what I have in this trash bin:
Graphic card: AMD Radeon HD 7000 Series
Processor: Intel Core i5-2500k CPU @ 3.30GHz 3.30 Ghz
Network driver: Realtek PCIe GBE Family Controller
RAM: 8.00GB
Motherboard: Msi ms-7678
PSU: Atx 480w power supply


(Did I get any spec or something wrong me, no pc much, and if you wanna know something else about my pc so you can try to help just ask)


It's shit but a survivor....but plz help. If not I won't be able to play and do an admin job properly for a while I don't know how long. But I will try my best to fix it, and I will be active same old on ts3 and Forums and admin meetings (all tho not next week)


But thanks for reading and no kickerino out of the admin teamirino plez [<3] [<3] 😘 Dankeschön!

Enjoy VACation 🙂 Greece is beautiful.


And I hope your PC will get ok 🙁

Have fun in Greece.


Your PSU should be doing fine tho.
